top_signals.title: Copper Smelters Face Worsening Squeeze as Negotiations Stall
top_signals.summary: Copper smelters are bracing for a period of extreme financial pressure as closely-watched negotiations over supply contracts for next year go down to the wire.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: U.S. adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist over export control concerns amid Nvidia controversy
top_signals.summary: The U.S. has added Megaspeed and six other companies to its trade blacklist over concerns about the potential diversion of advanced computing products.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Lula Fiscal Plan Approved in Bid to Calm Market After Real Tanks
top_signals.summary: Brazil’s lower house approved President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s plan to curb public spending just hours after the real weakened past the closely watched 6-per-dollar level, already a sign that investors doubt the measures can stabilize the country’s finances.
